summary: Paradium.AI filed an 8-K disclosing a ten-year Strategic Platform Agreement with RTB Digital, under which Paradium's brands, revenue and traffic migrate to RTB's AI-powered platform and Paradium licenses its technology assets. As consideration, RTB will issue Paradium unregistered RTB common stock valued at $11.5 million, subject to Nasdaq minimum pricing conditions. RTB also agreed to purchase a minority interest in Paradium. Closing, anticipated Q4 2026, is conditioned on diligence, RTB's capital raise and definitive documents. Watch financing risk, valuation of RTB shares and Nasdaq pricing compliance.
